items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: My mother's name is Elizabeth Handy.

ctx.x: Were your family musical? Everybody. What about your father, mother and your grandfather now?

Well, I don't know my grandfather. He died before I was big enough to know him. But my daddy played violin. My mother was a pianist. My sister's a pianist. My brother's a guitarist. And I got one player's bass. The one player's guitarist named Julius Handy. My sister's named Mary Louise Handy. My mother's name is Elizabeth Handy. My daddy's name is John Handy Sr.
What did you say your daddy played? Violin.
